transcript.content: Good [morning/afternoon]. I'm Dr. [Your Name], and I'll be conducting your evaluation today. Can you tell me what's been going on that brought you in to see me?

Um… mostly my eating, I guess. It kind of got away from me. I stopped keeping track of food like I normally do, and then I wasn’t really eating meals—just coffee, maybe a protein bar here and there. After a while my clothes were loose, and I hadn’t really… noticed until then.
Have you ever tried to make up for eating by making yourself sick, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual?
No… I don’t think so. I wasn’t, like, making myself throw up or taking stuff. I just wasn’t really eating much.
Have you been worried about gaining weight or noticed changes in how you feel about your body shape or weight?
Not really. I mean… I noticed my clothes fitting different, but I wasn’t sitting there worried about gaining weight or anything. I don’t know, I just wasn’t paying much attention.
Have there been times when you felt like you couldn’t control your eating, like you were eating much more than normal or couldn’t stop once you started?
No… not really. I don’t think I had times like that. It was more the opposite, I guess. I just wasn’t eating much.
Have you noticed a significant decrease in your appetite or found yourself not wanting to eat even when you know you should?

Yeah… my appetite dropped a lot. I kind of stopped doing real meals for a while. Mostly coffee, protein bars… I wasn’t really tracking or caring about food like I normally would. My clothes got loose before I really paid attention to it.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you normally like doing?

Yeah… I guess so. I haven’t really wanted to do the stuff I usually do. Hiking, editing photos… even the woodworking thing sitting in my garage. I haven’t touched it. And I stopped caring about logging meals too, which is not really like me. Those things usually help me feel steady, but lately I just… don’t feel like doing them.
Have you felt down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past couple of weeks?

Yeah… most days, I think. After the sponsor questioned my judgment, it just felt like the bottom dropped out. I was mostly sitting in my apartment feeling… hollow, ashamed. I cried over emails I normally would’ve just handled.
How long have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day?
About… three months, I think. Since that whole project thing happened. It’s just kind of stayed there most days.
Have you noticed that you feel tired or have lost energy nearly every day?
I don’t know… not in a clear way. I’ve been tired, I guess, but I haven’t really been keeping track of whether it’s every day.
Have you noticed any trouble thinking clearly, concentrating, or making decisions lately?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I’ve had trouble getting things done, but I don’t know if it’s concentration exactly. Decisions feel harder sometimes, I guess.
Have you noticed that you've been moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, that you can't sit still or keep your mind calm?

Yeah… more like I couldn’t sit still. I kept jumping between things — dashboards, timelines, strategy notes… even reorganizing my apartment and making new project templates. It felt hard to just stop.
Have you noticed that you feel tired or have lost energy almost every day, not just occasionally?
I don’t really know. I’ve been tired here and there, but I can’t say it’s been almost every day.
Have you felt like you’ve had no interest or pleasure in doing things, even the ones you usually enjoy, most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… I guess so. I haven’t really wanted to do the usual stuff — hiking, editing photos, logging meals. Even the woodworking thing in my garage, I’ve barely touched it. That’s not really like me.
Have you felt a loss of energy or felt tired nearly every day, not just some days?
I don’t think so… not nearly every day. Some days I’m worn out, but I haven’t really been tracking it like that.
Have you felt a loss of energy or felt tired almost every day, not just some days?
I mean… I don’t think it’s been almost every day. I’ve felt tired sometimes, but I can’t really say it’s that consistent.
Would you say that you’ve felt a loss of energy or felt tired nearly every day, not just some days?
I… I don’t really know. I haven’t been paying close enough attention to say it’s nearly every day. Some days, yeah, but… I can’t say more than that.
Would you say that you’ve felt a loss of energy or felt tired nearly every day, not just on and off?
I’m not sure I’d call it nearly every day. It’s kind of on and off, I guess.
Would you say that you’ve felt a loss of energy or felt tired almost every day, not just on and off?
I don’t think so. It’s more… here and there. I haven’t really tracked it that closely.
Would you say that your loss of energy or feeling tired has occurred nearly every day for the past two weeks, rather than just some days?
I don’t think I can say it’s been nearly every day. It’s just… some days I feel worn out, but I haven’t really been keeping count.
Would you say that your feeling of being down or depressed has occurred most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks at a time during this three-month period?

Yeah… there was a stretch like that. After the sponsor questioned my judgment, I kind of fell apart. I was mostly just in my apartment, feeling empty and ashamed. I’d cry over emails I normally would’ve just handled.
